messages:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's canary I see a reconnect storm from WS clients when we bumped ack_window_ms to 5000. Console shows a big jump in 'unacked' and then a flurry of reconnects. @ken can you take a look?
ken: On it. Do we know whether it's dropped frames, proxy idle, or client backpressure?
maria: Not frames. Pattern seems to be server emits events, clients delay their ack (backpressure), proxy treats connection as idle and tears it down -> clients reconnect and re-request. Reconnect rate went from ~0.3% to ~6% at peak. :eyes:
ops-bot: [ALERT] incident detected: streaming.reconnect_rate(Service=ingest-ws, region=prod-us-east-1) > 5% (5m window)
devon: Could be ELB/proxy idle timeouts interacting with ack window. Are health/probe intervals still 30s? Also check proxy idle. Example config we're running:```yaml
proxy:
  idle_timeout_s: 60
  probe_interval_s: 30
  ack_window_ms: 5000
```
lia: Also UX note: the console labels these as 'dropped' which is misleading — they're often replayed/duplicate deliveries. We should change the label and surface ack latency on the stream detail view; right now telemetry doesn't attach ack_delay to reconnect spans.
ken: I looked at proxy logs — it sends a RST when it considers a connection stale (heuristic: last-ack > 2 * ack_window). Canary increased ack_window but proxy heuristic wasn't updated, so timing windows misaligned. Quick repro I used: `curl --http2 -N https://ingest.example.com/ws -H 'X-Debug-Ack-Delay: 6000'` (simulate slow ack).
maria: Proposed quick fix: align proxy heuristic to use `ack_window_ms + jitter` and emit a span tag `ack_delay_ms` on reconnects so console can correlate. Long-term: add an alert for p95 ack_delay and a post-rollout test for streaming ack/backpressure.
devon: Agreed. Also note quota interaction: tenants who hit per-tenant `max_inflight` get throttled, their client acks pile up and then trigger the same cascade. We should add quota checks to the failure mode doc and to the rollout checklist.
ken: I'll prepare a patch to proxy to read the same ack_window config and expose `ack_delay_ms` in traces. Will gate behind feature-flag and canary tomorrow 11:00 PST. @lia can you update the dashboard text and add a small viz for ack_delay p50/p95?
lia: :thumbsup: Will update the dashboard, add the new metric, and append the UX note to the rollout doc.
maria: Thanks — if we align heuristics and surface the metric, we should catch these before they hit users on canary. I'll follow up with a short replay test we can include in the release playbook.
